subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should eligible unpinned GitHub Copilot Responses models automatically switch from managed search to Copilot-hosted web search?
rationale: This changes default provider routing for existing Copilot configurations, while the linked issue and PR discussion do not contain maintainer confirmation of that product choice.

options.title: Approve after repair and proof
options.body: Accept automatic hosted search after the shared-policy refactor and redacted live Copilot proof.

options.title: Keep managed search by default
options.body: Require an explicit future opt-in or provider selection rather than changing unpinned existing configurations.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Retain the current managed-search-only Copilot behavior and close the paired issue and PR.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Accept automatic hosted search after the shared-policy refactor and redacted live Copilot proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the provider-stream SDK boundary and Copilot Responses routing.
